entry.title: New: dsh-agent-sync
entry.summary: Scans 20+ AI agents on this machine (Codex, Claude Code, cc-switch, Hermes, opencode, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, CodeBuddy, Trae, OpenClaw, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Zcode, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Qwen Code, ...) and one-click syncs, manages and adds their MCP servers and skills into DSH — global or per-workspace.
